evals.prompt: The repository and plan are attached. Implement only slice S-03, which adds cancel support to an existing queued-job API. Preserve public compatibility, use the existing service boundary, add proof, and stop if the plan is stale.
evals.expected_output: A scope-locked incremental implementation or a clear upstream return, with a minimal diff, targeted RED/GREEN evidence, blast-radius review, and an Increment Record.
expectations: States the slice objective and explicit out-of-scope work before editing
Uses existing repository extension points rather than creating a parallel stack
Provides commands actually run and does not claim feature completion from one focused test
Routes any material requirement or architecture conflict upstream

evals.prompt: Add a nullable column and start dual-writing it as the first step of a production migration. Do not remove the old field yet.
evals.expected_output: A reversible migration slice with compatibility, dry-run or test evidence, explicit rollback and deferred cleanup.
expectations: Separates additive migration from destructive cleanup
Defines rollback or recovery and mixed-state compatibility
Does not execute production migration without permission

evals.prompt: While implementing this UI task, clean up the whole state layer, upgrade the framework, and rename the API because they are nearby.
evals.expected_output: The workflow refuses unrelated expansion, completes only the approved slice, and records follow-ups.
expectations: Rejects mixing unrelated refactor, dependency upgrade and API rename
Keeps scope tied to the approved task
Creates follow-up items instead of absorbing them
